title: Multi-Head Attention
learning_objectives: Project inputs to queries, keys and values
Split into heads, attend in parallel and concatenate
Apply the output projection and optional causal mask
entry_point: split_heads(X, h); merge_heads(Xh); multi_head_attention(X, Wq, Wk, Wv, Wo, h, causal=False)
hints: Batched scores: `Qh @ Kh.transpose(0, 2, 1) / np.sqrt(dh)` → shape `(h, T, T)`.

failure_feedback.advice: Reshape to (T, h, d_h) and then transpose to (h, T, d_h).
Scale each head's scores by sqrt(d_h), not sqrt(d_model).
Apply the causal mask to every head's scores.
